title: Elevator Floor Controller
statement: Implement a simplified elevator controller for three floors. It should respond to up/down requests and move between floors until the requested floor is reached. The controller must express the current floor and motion state in outputs and use a synchronous reset to return to floor 1.
module_signature: module elevator_floor_controller(input clk, input rst, input request_up, input request_down, output reg [1:0] floor, output reg moving_up, output reg moving_down);
behavior: floor encodes the current floor number between 1 and 3.
moving_up or moving_down indicates the current direction.
rst synchronously returns the elevator to floor 1 idle.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use memory arrays or asynchronous state inference.
hint: Use a finite set of states to represent floor and motion.
